"for up to six (6) months" exceeds the 90-day fallback minimum
"within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format"

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present in the inserted 10.3: 6-month transition assistance, then-current rates, 30-day return keyed to expiry or termination, standard machine-readable format, deletion thereafter, and written certification.

The deterministic check flagging the absence of an express 30-day return after expiry or termination is not borne out by the operative text: limb (b) reads "within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data".
The "at Customer's request" qualifier attaches only to limb (a) transition assistance; it does not swallow the mandatory data return, deletion, or certification duties in limbs (b) and (c).

Insertion is a concise single subsection filling a genuine gap (the original had no data-return or migration duty); no untouched sentence was altered and Sections 10.1, 10.2 and 16.5 remain effective, with 16.5's carve-out for Customer Data consistent with the new clause.

"reasonable" before transition assistance and "at Customer's request" are mild softeners inherent to a services-assistance mechanic and do not add a new exception or duplicate protection, so minimality is preserved.
